profile_text.body:
Rackspace Technology is a public company founded in 1998 and headquartered in San Antonio, trading under the ticker RXT. On its own site the company describes itself as a cloud computing services pioneer that delivers multicloud solutions across apps, data, and security, and says it has helped customers move from hosting to cloud to enterprise AI.

The site positions Rackspace around what it calls an Enterprise AI Cloud, describing a secure, regulated, compliant foundation built on AI-optimized hardware. The company says its engineers embed in customer environments to build, deploy, and operate AI workloads in production, and that it assembles and operates the full stack from governed private cloud to AI inference and agents in production, working with partners across the stack. It cites security, compliance, data sovereignty, and uptime as foundational, and names Financial Services, Healthcare, and Government among the industries it serves. The site quotes Dr. Zafar Chaudry, MD, Senior VP, Chief Digital Officer and Chief AI and Information Officer at Seattle Children's Hospital.

The record holds no tracked products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers for the company. Its SEC central index key is 0001810019.
